entities.name: Selective alkene reduction
observations: Input/output strings show one localized C=C bond changed to C-C in a complex heterocycle-containing substrate.
The generic ORD search returned noisy records and does not validate a specific protocol for this substrate.

entities.name: Alkene hydrogenation candidates
observations: Plausible reagent classes include H2 with Pd/C, poisoned Pd, transfer hydrogenation with Pd and ammonium formate or formic acid/amine, and diimide reduction.
Catalyst, pressure, time, and substrate heteroatoms will control chemoselectivity and over-reduction.
